Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE # 23042-T1

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.
6342-44-N. Pulaski RD.

The subject pruperty contains a 2-story commercial building and a parking lot. The
applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping
District to an RM5.5 Residential Multi-Unit District. The application is for a Type 1 Map
Amendment in order to allow the construction of a 3-story partial 4" story 9-dwelling
unit building with a basement, 8-rear parking spaces and 8-bicycle spaces.

PROJECT BULK AND DENSITY
Use: 9-Dwelling units
LOT AREA: 50’-0” x 124.13’=6206.5 square feet.

FLOOR AREA RATIO: 2.50

BUILDING FLOOR AREA: 15,516 square feet

MIN. LOT AREA/DWELLING UNIT: 688 square feet.
OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES: __ 8

ERONT SETBACK: Reduce from 14.88’ to 2’-0”

REAR SETBACK: Reduce from 37.2’ to 21’- 1 %2”

ONSITE OPEN SPACE: 400 square feet of common open space to be located on
the roof deck.

REAR YARD OPEN SPACE: 0

SIDE SETBACK: Reduce from 4’-0” to 3’-0” north, 1’-0” south and

total combination from 10’-0” to 4’-0”
BUILDING HEIGHT: 44 Feet
Pursuant to Section:17-13-0303-D. Optional Administrative Adjustments and Variations.
ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENTS and VARIATIONS: 17-13-1000, 17-13-1003-1,17-13-1003-J,

17-13-1100,17-13-1101-A,17-13-1101-B,17-13-1101-D and are seeking all zoning relief as needed
and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
